### 1. Popular & Heritage Denim Brands (Sale ya Discounts ke sath)

* **Levi's:[magicpin.in](https://magicpin.in/blog/category/fashion/brands-denims-men-2000#:~:text=From%20versatile%20cuts%20to%20comfortable%20fabrics%2C%20we've,1500-2000.%20Save%20more%20on%20Ajio%20with%20magicpin!)** Sale ya online platforms (Jaise Myntra ya Ajio) par Levi's ki classic aur slim-fit jeans aksar ₹1,500 se ₹2,000 ke budget mein mil jaati hain.[magicpin.in](https://magicpin.in/blog/category/fashion/brands-denims-men-2000#:~:text=From%20versatile%20cuts%20to%20comfortable%20fabrics%2C%20we've,1500-2000.%20Save%20more%20on%20Ajio%20with%20magicpin!) Yeh apni premium build quality aur long-lasting fabric ke liye jaane jaate hain.[magicpin.in](https://magicpin.in/blog/category/fashion/brands-denims-men-2000#:~:text=From%20versatile%20cuts%20to%20comfortable%20fabrics%2C%20we've,1500-2000.%20Save%20more%20on%20Ajio%20with%20magicpin!)
* **Pepe Jeans & Wrangler:[magicpin.in](https://magicpin.in/blog/category/fashion/brands-denims-men-2000)** Agar aapko rugged look ya modern cuts pasand hain, toh in brands ke kuch variants bhi discounted prices mein ₹2,000 ke andar mil jaate hain.[magicpin.in](https://magicpin.in/blog/category/fashion/brands-denims-men-2000#:~:text=*%202.%20Jack%20%26%20Jones%3A%20Elevate%20your,and%20style%20seamlessly%20combined%20in%20their%20offerings.)

### 2. Trendy & Pocket-Friendly Fashion Brands

* **The Indian Garage Co & Highlander:** Yeh online platforms par sabse zyada bikne wale brands mein se hain. Inki jeans ₹600 se ₹1,000 ke budget mein aaram se mil jaati hain aur daily wear ke liye stylish slim-fit options deti hain.
* **Roadster & Mast & Harbour:[www.myntra.com](https://www.myntra.com/men-jeans)** Myntra ke in in-house brands mein modern fits (skinny, straight, relaxed) ₹1,000 - ₹1,500 ki range mein badhiya variety ke sath milte hain.[www.numerounojeanswear.com](https://www.numerounojeanswear.com/collections/men-jeans-under-2000#:~:text=Whether%20you're%20into%20slim-fit%2C%20straight-cut%2C%20tapered%2C%20skinny%2C,Q%3A%20Are%20these%20jeans%20original%20branded%20products%3F)
* **WROGN:[www.myntra.com](https://www.myntra.com/men-jeans#:~:text=Men%20Straight%20Fit%20Jeans.%20Price%20Crash.%20%E2%82%B93%2C499.,Fit%20Jeans.%20Price%20Crash.%20%E2%82%B92%2C799.%2058%25%20OFF.)** Agar aapko thoda edgy aur trendy design chahiye, toh WROGN ki straight-fit ya light-fade jeans bhi ₹1,500 - ₹2,000 ke beech achieve ki ja sakti hain.

---

### Kuch Behtareen Options jo ₹2000 ke Andar Uplabdh Hain:

Yeh Levis Men's 541 Dark Blue Athletic Tapered Fit Mid Rise Jeans premium cotton fabric ke sath aati hain aur behtareen comfort provide karti hain.

Yeh WROGN Men Rugged Straight Fit Light Fade Jeans light fade aur rugged design ke sath milti hain jo casual wear ke liye ekdam perfect hain.

Yeh The IndianGarage Co Men Slim Fit Mid-Rise Jeans extremely soft finish aur rich look deti hain, woh bhi behad kam budget mein.

Yeh H&M Relaxed Jeans rigid cotton denim aur straight leg design ke sath aati hain jo relaxed fit pasand karne walon ke liye best hai.

Yeh Amazon Brand - Symbol Men Cotton Rich Stretchable Regular Fit Jeans cotton-poly stretch blend ke sath aati hain jo daily routine mein poora comfort deti hain.
